name: Karnataka Arundhati Scheme
department: Karnataka State Brahmin Development Board, Govt of Karnataka
short_description: Financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 for marriages of economically weaker families in Karnataka.
detailed_description: The Arundhati scheme provides financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 to economically weaker brides from recognized communities in Karnataka having EWS certificates and family annual income below Rs. 8 Lakh.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಬಡ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳ ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ವಿವಾಹಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ರೂ. 25,000 ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸಹಾಯ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you a resident of Karnataka?

rules.name: Bride Age at least 18
rules.source_citation: Arundhati Rules Section 3 (Legal Age of Marriage)
rules.clarification_question_en: What is the age of the bride?

benefits_summary: One-time financial grant of Rs. 25,000 via DBT into the bride's bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Bride and Groom
Marriage Registration Certificate / Marriage Invitation card
application_process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in).
Enter Aadhaar and EWS certificate number.
Upload wedding invitation and marriage registration details.
source_title: Karnataka State Development Board, Govt of Karnataka
source_excerpt: Under Arundhati scheme, financial assistance of Rs. 25,000 is given to economically weaker brides for their marriage expenses.
